question: What recitation must be performed if the upper staff of the flag is missing?
premises: The upper staff may be deficient
Recitation is prescribed as a remedy
The lord of the flag is to be recited one hundred times
inference: If the upper staff is deficient, one should recite the lord of the flag one hundred times.
uncertainties: dhvajasyeśaṃ taken as invocation of the lord of the flag
plain_english: If the upper staff is deficient, one should recite the name of the lord of the flag one hundred times.
